text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, after Yukino Bijin has a number of victories under her belt…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hot diggity dog!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wow, this place looks like a castle! I can't believe this is the place we get t'stay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin has dug out the coupon she won and brought us on our long-awaited hot spring vacation.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I just love hot springs! Soak'n in the water feels so good, like your whole body's melt'n into a puddle…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yep! There's actually a trick to it…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You just let all your muscles go slack and let the water carry you. Then you'll start float'n, totally weightless.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Next thing y'know, you' ve become one with the water.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But you gotta be careful! If you zone out too much, your mind'll float right off along with your body!
choice_data_list: Er… and has that happened to you before?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Yes.

text_block_list.name: Tourist A
text_block_list.text: Hey… Isn't that Yukino Bijin over there?

text_block_list.name: Tourist B
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you're right! I can't believe it! Wanna go ask for a photo? We can post it on Umastagram after!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin's popularity hasn't shown signs of flagging after she put herself on everyone's radar again. At her request, I usually let her deal with fans herself now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, hold on, Trainer. I'll just—
choice_data_list: It's okay. Leave this to me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tourist B
text_block_list.text: Oh, uh… Yes?
choice_data_list: I couldn't help but overhear… Sorry, but Yukino is on break today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Interacting with her fans brings her a lot of joy. But just for today, I'd like her to forget her responsibilities and relax.
choice_data_list: Would it possible for you to pretend you didn't see us here?

text_block_list.name: Tourist A
text_block_list.text: Oh, sorry, we didn't realize… I guess we just got a little excited.

text_block_list.name: Tourist B
text_block_list.text: Of course! We won't post about this anywhere! Sorry, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks for look'n out for me, Trainer.
choice_data_list: I did it for me, actually.
I did it for me, actually.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
choice_data_list: I wanted to talk with you without anyone distracting us.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, gosh! Th-that's…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um, uh… Shall we go, then?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! That water was to die for!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I sure did! My body's all loosey-goosey now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It felt like a real luxury hav'n the whole bath t'myself! I treasured ev'ry second of it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It'd sure be nice if I could bring my family, Mifuyu, and all the folks back in Morioka here one day!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna need t'put in some real work if I wanna rent this whole place out, though!
choice_data_list: Sounds like you've found a new dream.
Sounds like you've found a new dream.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Seems like I have!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …A dream, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Actually… I already found m'self another dream.
choice_data_list: Can I ask what it is?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: N-never mind! Forget I said anyth'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …O-oh yeah! I almost forgot. Mifuyu asked me t'send her pictures of the inn!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Be back in a jiff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's getting a little late, and it could be dangerous for her to wander around on her own, so I decide to go after her.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I tried t'say it, but I just can't!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I mean, you shoulda heard Trainer just now…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I can't follow someth'n like that with begg'n for us to keep work'n together!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Uuurgh, I know. I know, but…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Anyway, Trainer's wait'n for me, so… Good gracious! I am not runn'n away! Anyway, g'night, Mifuyu.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sigh… She's always teas'n me…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: T-T-Trainer!
choice_data_list: Don't worry, we've still got plenty of races ahead of us.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: R-righty-roo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense that Yukino Bijin and I have formed an irreplaceable bond during this time together.
